gotchas: Same storefront as urbanoutfitters.com and freepeople.com: the same search, product, /cart and one-page /checkout route, and the same field names on the guest form.

Guessing a /shop/<slug> URL does not work here. Every slug tried rendered the we cannot seem to find what you are looking for page, whose quick-add tiles swallow an add click and leave the basket empty with Proceed To Checkout disabled. Reach the product page by pressing Enter on the named search tile from /search?q=<term>, which navigated on every attempt.

The add button is addressed by aria-label, button[aria-label='Add to Basket']. Text matching counts 0 even though the accessibility tree shows that name. Wait about 15 seconds after the product page opens before probing the buy box.

The header bag count does not appear under [aria-label*='Product Count'] on this host, so do not use it as the add-succeeded check. Open /cart and count button:has-text('Proceed to Checkout'):not([disabled]) instead.
The bag copy says basket rather than bag, so the empty-bag marker here is the text Sign in to view basket items.

The button that leaves the shipping step is Ship to this address, not Continue. button:has-text('Continue') counts 0 on this host and a run that keyed off it burned a minute on click and Enter timeouts. Text matching ignores case, so one selector covers the capitalized variant on the sister sites.
The street field is a combobox with an autocomplete popup. Press Escape after filling it and the typed value stays.

The payment step renders Stripe Elements, five iframes whose source is Stripe's, beside a Credit Card option and a Place Order button. The card-number frame itself was not pinned down, so start from the Stripe iframe selector and validate the inner selector on first use.

DataDome fronts every host on this platform and refuses datacenter egress with a 403, on plain requests as well as in a browser. That is an egress problem rather than a selector problem, and it is why none of this could be checked locally.
notes: Driven through the Agent Vault proxy in September 2026 from search to the payment step: the named search tile, Add to Basket, /cart, Proceed To Checkout, the one-page guest form filled field by field, Ship to this address, then Stripe Elements beside a Place Order button. The card was not filled, so the status is unverified, and the card-number selector inside the Stripe frames is still unknown. The run took about 174 seconds and every action was accepted once the right selector was used.
